options.reason: This is a transactional retail log with no plausible outcome column: the evident purpose is segmenting anonymous customers from their purchase behaviour, so rows (invoice lines) should be rolled up per CustomerID into recency/frequency/monetary-style features and clustered; InvoiceDate is used only to derive recency relative to an observation date, not as a partition time column, and InvoiceNo/StockCode are record-level keys.
options.title: clustering
